text:
incident-bot: Pager: p99 latency breach on /v1/generate-stream (prod-us-east-1). p99 ~ 2.7s (SLO 1.5s). Increased tail stalls during streaming. No large error spike but several customer sessions reported streaming stalls. Paging oncall: alice.

alice (oncall): I’m on it. Pulling traces and profiler. Anyone see recent deploys? @deploy-bot status? :mag:

deploy-bot: CI deploy to prod-us-east-1 completed 4m ago (service: preproc-renderer, version: v3.12.0). Canary was green.

ben (eng-runtime): seeing elevated time in prompt-preprocessing step in traces — tokenizer + template render path. p95s up modestly but p99 dominated by single-threaded template render calls.

carmen (eng-sre): CPU of preproc pods spiking to 90% on a subset of nodes. Autoscaler didn’t respond immediately because pods were CPU-throttled.

alice (oncall): can you paste a flame/sample?

ben (eng-runtime): attaching recent stackish snippet:

```
# sample span
span: preprocess.render_template (duration: 1200ms)
  -> tokenize.prompt (duration: 200ms)
  -> render.json_mode (duration: 900ms)  <-- hot
  -> kv-cache.lookup (duration: 50ms)
```

ben (eng-runtime): render.json_mode is the big one — looks like a new JSON-mode template path in v3.12.0 that attempts expensive schema validation + pretty-printing per request.

dinesh (product): We did push a change to template rendering to do stronger validation for tool-schema outputs. Intended to catch malformed assistant outputs for tool-calls. Was gated behind a feature flag but maybe flag defaulted on for certain tenants.

eve (support): Support reports 8 customers in last 15m saw streaming stalls (UI froze mid-stream, resumed after 6-8s). One customer on Dedicated called in.

luis (infra): Node-level metrics: pods hitting CPU limit and sometimes OOM-kill on helper sidecars (json-formatter). Not seeing network saturation.

carmen (eng-sre): quick mitigation idea: flip feature-flag off for strict-json-validation, or route streaming traffic to legacy preproc pool that uses faster non-validated renderer. Can we do that quickly?

alice (oncall): Steps? Prioritize minimal blast radius.

ben (eng-runtime): Proposed runbook actions:
1) Disable strict-json-validation FF globally for prod (targeted toggle) -> reduces expensive schema checks.
2) If toggle not available, rollback preproc-renderer v3.12.0 canary to v3.11.x for affected region.
3) Temporarily scale up preproc-renderer CPU quota for the hot pods and increase HPA max to absorb burst.
4) Add short-term rate-limit on streaming endpoints for free-tier to reduce tail pressure.

alice (oncall): I’ll try FF toggle first. @luis can you prep a quick HPA bump if toggle fails? @deploy-bot can we patch FF?

luis (infra): prepping autoscale command, ready to run.

deploy-bot: Feature flag manager endpoint: PATCH /flags/strict_json_validation -> false (auth required).

alice (oncall): Executing: PATCH /flags/strict_json_validation false.

(30s later)

alice (oncall): Patch applied. Observing metrics... p99 dropping from 2.7s -> 1.6s in the first 60s. Still slightly above SLO but much better.

carmen (eng-sre): Good. Keep monitoring for 10m. I’ll watch for any downstream errors from turning validation off.

ben (eng-runtime): Logs show per-request render time now ~120ms, JSON-mode path no longer doing heavy validation. Streaming stalls decreased.

dinesh (product): We need to notify customers and mark as mitigation. Also plan to rework validation into async post-process / background check so it doesn’t block streaming.

eve (support): I’ll notify affected customers: short note that we observed streaming stalls due to template validation and we mitigated by disabling strict validation; follow-up with timeline and permanent fix ETA.

alice (oncall): Because deploy was recent, I want a rollback PR ready in case FF flip didn’t work. @ben can you open rollback PR and link?

ben (eng-runtime): Opening rollback PR for v3.11 immediate revert: https://git.internal/redwood/preproc-renderer/pull/4823. Marking hold unless we need.

luis (infra): HPA bump ready but not executed. Recommend holding since FF toggle reduced CPU.

carmen (eng-sre): Watching p99 and CPU. Adding a temporary alert suppress for pager floods for next 10m (so we don't re-pager while we assess).

alice (oncall): Good call. I’ll prepare incident summary for postmortem and do on-call handoff in 30m. Next oncall: ben (overnight).

ben (eng-runtime): Will take handoff. Action items I’m owning: rewrite validation to async, add opt-in stricter checks per-tenant, add test coverage for template perf, and prepare safe default for FF.

dinesh (product): Product action: audit tenants that have stricter validation on by default; we likely flipped default for a cohort during rollout.

eve (support): Customer notifications queued, one high-touch customer asked for rollback to dedicated pool — we offered fallback to dedicated capacity and they accepted; ops will schedule.

carmen (eng-sre): After 12m of stable metrics (p99 ~1.45s), I will close the mitigation and mark incident as mitigated.

alice (oncall): Closing notes before handoff: cause = CPU-heavy JSON-mode schema validation introduced in v3.12.0 + feature flag default for a cohort + HPA not scaling fast due to CPU throttling. Mitigation = disabled strict validation FF, autoscale ready but not required, rollback PR opened. Customer impact = streaming stalls for ~8-12 customers, one dedicated customer impacted UI stalls but no data loss.

alice (oncall): Handoff to @ben in 30m. Please keep the thread for follow-ups and list any longterm RCA items. :white_check_mark:

(10m later)

ben (eng-runtime): Taking handoff. I'll coordinate with infra to convert validation to background job and add perf budget tests. Logging RCA ticket: INC-2165439999-RCA.

carmen (eng-sre): Incident mitigated and moved to monitoring. I'll create postmortem doc and include timeline, graphs, and action items.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: Sev2.

ben (eng-runtime): Quick todo list (short): ["convert strict validation to async background check", "add FF default audit", "add perf unit tests for template render", "improve HPA CPU headroom/tuning", "customer comms follow-up"].

alice (oncall): Thanks team. Handoff complete.

(30m later)

carmen (eng-sre): formal postmortem draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2165439999-draft. Will ping for reviews.

end of thread.
